tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check real-time availability for one date. Returns the open start times in 24-hour HH:MM (Reykjavik time), the session length for the party, a pre-filled booking URL and the price. An empty list means the date is fully booked or the studio is closed, not an error. The price is 16 000 ISK per person, charged in ISK.

date.description: Date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later, within 548 days.

participants.description: Number of people in the session (1-20; more than 8 are arranged with the studio). Defaults to 1.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, CNY) shown as an approximate reference beside the price. The price itself is in ISK and is charged in ISK. Unknown codes are ignored.

tools.name: find_next_available
tools.description: Scan the coming days and return the first dates that have open start times. Use it when a visitor has no date in mind, or when the date they asked for is full.

participants.description: Number of people in the session.

start_date.description: Optional first day of the scan, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, CNY) shown as an approximate reference beside the price. The price itself is in ISK and is charged in ISK. Unknown codes are ignored.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The price of a session (a flat rate per person, all ages, charged in ISK), what every session includes, the optional print sizes with their prices, and gift-card validity. Other currencies are approximate references at the day's rate.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, CNY) shown as an approximate reference beside the price. The price itself is in ISK and is charged in ISK. Unknown codes are ignored.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Opening hours, street address, coordinates of the entrance, phone, email and booking policy of Mink Viking Experience in Reykjavik.

tools.name: get_booking_url
tools.description: A booking URL that opens the booking page with the date and the number of people already chosen. Use it as the last step of a booking conversation: the visitor picks a start time and pays on the website.
